user.title: Home Voice Safety Layer
user.description: Tick the devices that must ask for confirmation before they act. {count} candidate(s) were found. The reviewed catalog and policy are written to /config/home_voice_safety/ automatically; no path typing is needed.

tuning.title: Safety tuning
tuning.description: Confirmation TTL and the dedup window are safety parameters, not convenience settings. A shorter dedup window makes repeated commands easier to dispatch twice.

data.nlu_provider: Intent parser: rule (offline deterministic) or llm (local Ollama)
data.real_entities: Real device entity_ids, comma separated; the rest are labelled simulated
